clue.text: Male with inclination to engage in securing deliveries?

indicators.note: something blocking a passage sits in the middle of it, so ALAS sits in the middle of the country

explanation.surface: A big southern region sadly shut out of a European country.

clue.text: Soldiers with tale about irrational gunners getting out of breath

explanation.surface: Soldiers telling tales about crazed gunners are left breathless.
